intro.title: Cats Eye Bracelets
intro.description: Amazing collection of Cats Eye Bracelets in various designs. Cat's Eye Gemstone is available in various shades of yellow to brown to green. Cat's Eye is also called Lehsuniya in Hindi and the high end chrysoberyl version is called Kanak Kheth. Cat's Eye get the name as the stone resembles a Cat's Eye with a hue in the middle because of mineral deposits. Cat's Eye is ruled by Planet Ketu and is one of most powerful Gemstones that blesses the wearer with stability, protection and good fortune.
